topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 68 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 6 ERC20 tokens, 4 ERC721 NFTs, 1 ERC1155 multi-token; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 2 common project-authored base contract(s) (safeownable, bep20). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
